findings.title: The Call as Gathering
findings.claim: On the resurrection Day, the call draws the addressed group into response, while their remembered stay contracts to little; the wider scenes let this sequence be read as a gathering enacted by address alongside bodily rising.
findings.mechanism: In the focus, yad'ukum is followed by fa-tastajibun and then by the estimate of a short stay. The caller followed by everyone in 20:108 and the dispersal-to-gathering relation in 67:24 make the focus call draw the scattered toward assembly; 50:44 adds earth splitting, swift emergence, and easy gathering, giving the response a passage into presence. Separately, 23:112-114 asks how long people remained, offers a day-or-part-day estimate, and calls the stay little; 79:46 likewise makes residence appear no longer than an evening or morning. These contacts make the Day a threshold for both responsive gathering and retrospective time compression.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene can be perceived as a company being gathered through a summons and answer, while the duration of their prior stay is recast from the far side of the event.
findings.containment: This reading accompanies bodily raising rather than replacing it. The focus does not say that the call causes reconstitution, establish whether reconstitution precedes the call, or fix the objective duration of the stay. The cut and gap images are analogical.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run support and exact focus forms ground the call-response and short-stay relation; the linked verses supply exact Arabic but not target morphology. The cutting and open-gap facets are analogical and remain bounded as such.

findings.title: Recognition and Estimate

Separately, 23:112 asks how long the residence lasted, 23:113 offers a day or part of a day, and 23:114 calls the stay little if only they knew. These different contacts let conviction and uncertainty remain audible together without choosing one.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear recognition of the event alongside uncertainty about how much time had passed.
findings.containment: No word explicitly names a new sign or asserts complete knowledge, and none of the duration parallels fixes this stay's length. The confident reading remains exploratory and does not displace the fallible estimate.

epistemic.reason: The focus word and branch records are supplied, and the duration exchange is explicit. The confident branch is a multi-step inference from the prior call-and-praise act; the HFT summary has no anchored trace, so both readings are qualified without treating that summary as proof.
